name: rules-rtdb-r13-cross-tree-lookup
description: RTDB rules production verdicts for corpus scenario "r13-cross-tree-lookup" (rtdb#71). Captured by deploy-observe-restore (RTDB has no server-side rules test API). a message rule that authorizes against the room membership list two levels up (data.parent().parent().child(...)) — production must resolve the same sibling subtree the simulator does — plus a root-level maintenance flag and a path with no rule at all (deny by default).
